# Python dependencies for the vendored dictation scripts.
# Pinned by `make py-bootstrap` via pip freeze after install (D-04).
# Versions left floating (>=) so pip can resolve the latest compatible
# release at venv-build time; the resulting freeze is the authoritative
# lock for reproducible deploys.
#
# See D-03 (vendor) and D-04 (venv) in
# .planning/phases/03-python-cli-integration/03-CONTEXT.md.

# fsrs — Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler engine.
# Imported by vocab_manager.py (from fsrs import ...).
fsrs>=0.0.1

# requests — HTTP client for Volcengine TTS calls.
# Imported by pregenerate_dictation.py (import requests).
requests>=2.31.0

# edge-tts — Microsoft Edge TTS fallback for direct provider calls.
# Imported by pregenerate_dictation.py (import edge_tts) for the
# contextual TTS 2.0 fallback path.
edge-tts>=6.1.0
